senses.gloss: f. (denom. of זָר) the legal status of the non-priest, the laws concerning non-priests.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 5:1:10">Y. Ter. V, 43ᶜ</cite> <he>איסור ז׳</he> the prohibition as far as it concerns the T’rumah to be eaten by non-priests.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:2:10">Y. Bicc. II, 65ᵃ</cite> <he>היתר ז׳</he> inasmuch as they are permitted to non-priests.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 2:9:3">Y. Orl. II, end, 62ᶜ</cite> <he>משום ז׳</he> for violating the law forbidding non-priests &c.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 68b:2">Yeb. 68ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <he>וכל זר</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 22:10">Lev. XXII, 10</cite>) <he>ז׳ אמרתי לך וכ׳</he> the Law treats of non-priests, but not of the mourners; a. e.
